title: Careers & Jobs with Kamailio
html:
There are many opportunities for those looking to pursue a career in real time communications with SIP and Kamailio as well as projects related to this area.

Here are several announced within Kamailio project environment:

  • Sipwise (Austria)
  • Sipgate (Germany)
  • 1&1 (Germany)
  • Ifbyphone (USA)
  • Asipto (Germany)
  • ITCenter (Portugal)

If you have an open position in your enterprise that is related to Kamailio in some way, send an email to mailing list <business [at] lists.kamailio.org> and you will be listed in this post.
